changelog: Health output moves outside the skill install dir (GARMIN_PULSE_HEALTH_DIR / XDG default / --output-dir; legacy in-package health/ still works) so registry updates apply cleanly.
summary: Syncs daily health and fitness data from Garmin Connect into markdown files. Sleep, activity, heart rate, stress, body battery, HRV, SpO2, weight, hydration, training status, endurance/hill scores, race predictions.
